question: How can I add a callout note in my OpenAPI endpoint description to indicate that authentication is required?
ground_truth: You can add a callout note in your OpenAPI endpoint description by including Markdown in the `description` field. For example, use `<Note>This endpoint requires authentication.</Note>` within the description field of your endpoint definition in the OpenAPI specification.

metadata.cited_context:
If you're using OpenAPI to define your API, you can include Markdown content in your OpenAPI Specification. For example, you can include a callout in the `description` field of an endpoint:

```yaml title="api/openapi.yml"
paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      summary: List all pets
      description: |
        Get a list of all pets in the system.

        <Note>This endpoint requires authentication.</Note>
```
